name: hud_layout_base_disable
description: HudLayoutBase::Disable dispatches the layout set-active slot with active=0.
known_limits: Tier C first; the existing VC target hud_layout_base_enable_disable covers the Enable/Disable pair.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly and decompilation for 0x412c00 validate loading the layout ftable from self, pushing active value 0, and indirectly calling slot offset 0x04.
The native layout shutdown smoke installs a test SetActive slot, calls HudLayoutBase::Disable, and verifies the dispatched active value is 0.
